title: The Cat Dish Too Far from the Step
youtube_title: The Cat Dish Too Far from the Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who is tired is already a gentle skill.
summary: At a library return desk and the rainy steps, a cat dish that had been left too far from the dry step is awkward for one person. Lior notices Mr. Ade struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
